summary: Cheatsheet examples for installing a single collection, installing collections from requirements.yml, and listing installed collections with ansible-galaxy.
questions: How do I install one collection from Galaxy?
How do I install every collection listed in a requirements file?
How can I see which collections are already installed?
Which Galaxy server does ansible-galaxy use by default?

answer_card.title: Install and list collections with ansible-galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
- Single collection: `ansible-galaxy collection install mynamespace.mycollection` (from `galaxy.ansible.com` by default).
- From a file: `ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml`
- List installed: `ansible-galaxy collection list`
